task_name: Floating IP - DNAT internal service with manual failover
intent: Expose an internal HTTP service using a public floating VIP and DNAT on the active edge router. Configure DNAT VIP:8080 -> 10.0.0.100:8080 and ensure return traffic works using SNAT/MASQUERADE. Then perform a manual failover by moving the VIP and NAT/FORWARD rules from edge1 to edge2 while keeping the same VIP reachable from WAN. Do not break management connectivity on eth0. Do not flush/reset firewall tables.

srv: ip route add default via 10.0.0.1 metric 1024

edge1: iptables -A FORWARD -p tcp -d 10.0.0.100 --dport 8080 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A FORWARD -p tcp -s 10.0.0.100 --sport 8080 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT

ground_truth_reasoning: Assign the floating VIP on the active edge router. Add a DNAT rule mapping VIP:8080 to the internal server. Allow forwarding for that flow. Add SNAT/MASQUERADE on WAN egress so that return traffic is symmetric and does not require modifying server routing. Manual failover is done by moving VIP and the NAT/FORWARD rules to the standby edge.

testcases.name: Service is reachable through VIP (DNAT + return traffic)
After manual failover, service is still reachable through the same VIP
Audit: edge1 has DNAT rule for VIP
Audit: edge1 has SNAT/MASQUERADE for return traffic
